description: SereneDB test-config for the vendored duckdb_quack test suite and DuckDB's tests that attach QUACK_SERVER. tests/duckdb/quack/run.sh runs each file against a serened of its own that serves quack, instead of the quack_serve server of the test's DuckDB process.

skip_tests.reason: serened serves quack from an HTTP listener (`?api=quack`), so the quack extension has no server to run from SQL: quack_serve, quack_stop, quack_server_list, quack_generate_keys, the quack_server_* settings and the quack_authentication_function / quack_authorization_function hooks do not exist. Every file below tests starting, stopping or configuring a server from SQL.
The quack build in SereneDB has no whoami(), quack_identify or whoami_* settings: nothing in SereneDB reads a server's description of itself.

self_connect.test checks that a statement is refused when it comes back to the server through the session that runs it, which only a server in the client's own process can do. A SereneDB server attaches its own quack listener through a session of its own.
